title: Twitter Performance Analysis - Jan 31st -  Dec 31th 2022
body:
Below is a Performance Overview of our Twitter posts for our Edgeware DAO.

This is a comprehensive look at our 2022 Social Media Communications. 

Continued thank you to Gagan for his monthly tracking and posting of our data...
Please see the link for his excel report: [https://onedrive.live.com/view.aspx?resid=4326C4CAE1B046BA!35406&ithint=file%2cxlsx&authkey=!AOfEK026AJmRO8g](https://onedrive.live.com/view.aspx?resid=4326C4CAE1B046BA!35406&ithint=file%2cxlsx&authkey=!AOfEK026AJmRO8g)


The visuals below, are an overview of our Twitter Performance categorized and compared by the following:
1. **Average Engagement Rate**
2. **Replies & Quotes**
3. **Retweets**
4. **URL Clicks**
5. **Profile Clicks**
6. **Favorites**
7. **Engagements**
8. **Impressions**




![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/00745112-fc9c-43db-a6ca-00ebd5d47244.1680046072635)


The Types have been consolidated to 7 

1. Operations
2. Governance
3. Community Call
4. Feature
5. Financial
6. Kabocha
7. Interview /AMA



Since November...
Our overall Engagement Rate% has decreased from _**3.90**%_ to _**3.87**%_
1. Tweets related our **Features,** continues to leads our _Engagement rate. ( _≈ _5.9% )_
2. Tweets related to our **Operations** leads in the other 6 categories ( _Replies, Quotes and Retweets, URL, Profile clicks and Total Engagements)_




![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/184f575b-65f8-42d6-b224-5592f81b52aa.1680047239877)
